newsitem.title: USA: Edison, Mechanical Technology sign venture deal.
newsitem.headline: Edison, Mechanical Technology sign venture deal.

text.p: Edison Development Corp, a subsidiary of DTE Energy Co, said Wednesday it and Mechanical Technology Inc signed a final agreement to form the joint venture Plug Power LLC.

The venture was established to develop and manufacture fuel cells which convert natural gas to electricity without combustion. The companies said they intend to create a fuel cell about the size of a central air conditioner which can provide electricity to residential customers.

Gary Mittleman was named president and chief executive officer of Plug Power. He previously served as assistant vice president for business development at DTE Energy's Detroit Edison subsidiary and president of Edison Development Corp.
The venture will seek additional partners such as chemical companies and high-technology firms.
Edison has been involved in business development activities since 1993. Mechanical Technology is a high-technology company.
